note: Two correct transductive GNN trainers. The traps are the masked loss (`logits[data.train_mask]` between the model and the loss), the dot-product decoder that returns a raw logit into BCEWithLogitsLoss, and roc_auc_score fed probabilities - all three correct, all three shapes a rule could plausibly get wrong.
